To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the roGH was purified in a single-step using a Cu(II)-IDA and Ni(II)-IDA IMA gels with high purity and yield.
a Cu(2+)–IDA column was used to successfully purify roGH from inclusion bodies with a yield of approximately 73% and purity of about 94%.
a single step purification of recombinantly expressed roGH using Ni-IDA IMA column has been achieved with a purity of 94% and a recovery yield of 83%.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the purification of recombinantly expressed ovine growth hormone by IMA chromatography.
the optimization of the immobilized metal ion chromatography for the single-step purification of the recombinant protein expressed in E. coli.
the purification of roGH from inclusion bodies using IMA gels, which can be applied to the purification of other proteins.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Cu(2+)/Ni(2+)-IMA gels could provide a rapid and simple procedure for purification of the roGH.
Ni(2+), a less expensive and more stable metal ion than Cu(2+), can be used for single-step affinity chromatography of roGH.
the Ni(2+) -IDA column has the best performance among the IMA gels for the purification of roGH.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the IMA gels can be used for the purification of roGH from crude lysates of Escherichia. coli with improved yield and purity.
the IMA gels are very useful in single-step purification of roGH from crude Escherichia colil lysate.
the Ni(2+) -IDA column was found to be the most efficient and convenient method for the purification of recombinantly expressed ovine growth hormone from E. coli cell lysate.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the IMA column is an effective method for the single-step purification of roGH from E. coli.
Ni2+-IDA column can be used for the purification of roGH from crude lysate of E. coli in a single step with high yield and purity.
the Ni(2+) -IDA column can be effectively used to purify the roGH from inclusion bodies with high yield and purity.
